name: tasks
description: Plan and track development work with Markdown task files, an explicit dependency graph, and optional epics for large plans.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and track dependency-aware project tasks
interface.longDescription: Turn a project or feature into a Markdown plan, dependency graph, per-task specifications, and progress log, then keep them synchronized as work changes. Large plans group into structural epics so each read stays small.
defaultPrompt: Use $task-tracking to break this project into dependency-aware tasks.
Use $task-tracking to show me what work is unblocked next.
Use $task-tracking to mark my current task complete.
Use $task-tracking to group my task list into epics.
